$comment: Canonical event catalog for the RT ABA Tracker integration bus. This is THE contract shared by every producer (PWA, video device, wearable SDK) and every consumer (BigQuery warehouse, LHBM training + inference, VANT dashboard, webhooks). It formalizes the in-app EventBus vocabulary (f17) into a versioned, transport-agnostic schema. Pairs with analyst/semantic/schema.json (the warehouse data dictionary).

envelope.$comment: Every event on the bus shares this envelope. payload shape is per event type below.

eventId.desc: UUID v4, unique per event — idempotency key for the bus (dedup on redelivery).

v.desc: Schema version of this event type (starts at 1).

ts.desc: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the event occurred (device clock).

submissionId.desc: Stable session id — correlates all events of one session; matches sessions.submission_id in BigQuery. THE join key across the bus.

clientId.desc: Patient id (FK clients.id). PHI-adjacent — pseudonymize for training.

therapistEmail.desc: Producer identity (also the auth subject for device tokens).

deviceId.desc: Opaque device id (for device-token auth + provenance). Optional for pwa.

envelope.delivery: at-least-once; consumers MUST dedup on eventId. Session-level dedup uses submissionId (already enforced server-side by _sessionAlreadyRecorded).

session.paused.$comment: Transient/operational (Suspended Sessions). Not a warehouse fact; useful as a real-time signal + for engagement analytics.

behavior.recorded.$comment: One event per behavior count change (or a per-session rollup). Wearable/video can emit the SAME event type once VANT (Phase 3) auto-detects behaviors — this is where multimodal corroboration happens.

payload.promptLevel: string (I|VT|G|V|M|PP|FP) — f30a. ONE level per goal per session: the level the goal was PROGRAMMED to run at (BCBA sign-off Oct 2026), not a summary of what each trial needed. I=Independent, VT=Visual/Textual, G=Gestural, V=Verbal, M=Model, PP=Partial Physical, FP=Full Physical — least to most support. Blank means the goal was not run, which is NOT the same as Independent. The code is authoritative; rank is derived from this order, so the order can change with no migration. HIGH-VALUE LHBM signal and the label space for video annotation (v4) and skeleton classification (s3).
payload.trialTimes: array<string> — ISO-8601 per trial, stamped automatically with no therapist action (f30a). Exists so trial data can be aligned to video, skeleton and wearable timelines, which a session date alone cannot support.
payload.firstScoredAt: string (ISO-8601) — when this goal block was first scored.
payload.lastScoredAt: string (ISO-8601) — when it was last scored.

session.completed.$comment: Terminal event. Carries billing + signature metadata. Idempotent via submissionId.

consent.recorded.$comment: Parent consent (session signature f28 today; recording consent v6 for Phase 2 video). Revocable.

inference.requested.$comment: Real-time (Phase C). A behavioral profile sent to the LHBM inference API (m16). Response is inference.produced.

inference.produced.$comment: LHBM output → drives wearable push (JUAN l7), smart notes (m17), pattern alerts (m18).

notes.training_use: For LHBM training, consume the warehouse tables built from these events (not raw events). Apply the de-identification exclusions in analyst/semantic/schema.json (notes, names, antecedent/consequence, authorization_number). Filter is_draft.
notes.wearables: JUAN (l7/l8) is BOTH a producer (behavior.recorded via sensors) and a consumer (inference.produced → haptic/audio). It needs device-token auth (f26a) and the real-time broker (f26b).
notes.evolution: Add new event types or bump a type's v; never repurpose an existing field. Producers may emit a subset; consumers must tolerate unknown fields (forward-compatible).
